text:
mira: quick sync - Helios Health onboarding tomorrow at 11am PT. goal before enablement: finalize SLO wording, reporting cadence, and a worked credit example for procurement. renewal risk: low but finance wants clarity on monthly credit calc.

jared: ok. do we have the pilot latency numbers handy? i recall a p95 tail last Tue.

sam: yes, dashboard snapshot: p50 ~ 60ms, p90 ~ 310ms (spike window 04/03 09:20-09:45), p99 ~ 980ms for long requests. uptime 99.96 over last 30 days.

ana: customer asks: (1) weekly SLO digest via email, (2) one-pager that shows example credit math if we miss latency SLOs.

mira: draft SLOs for onboarding (0-90d): uptime >= 99.95% monthly; p90 latency <= 300ms for interactive routes (<=750 tokens); p99 latency <= 900ms for same. Weekly digest (Mon) + monthly SLA PDF. Credits: single-month breach -> pro-rata credit; repeated >2 months -> renewal review. thoughts?

jared: p90 300ms is more realistic on Hosted. agree to scope to interactive routes only. add a line about excluded batch/embeddings.

evan: engineering note: with current routing and model quantization, Hosted should meet p90 300ms for short prompts. For longer contexts we see p99 spikes. recommend we include fallback policy: auto-fallback to smaller model for 3 minutes when p90 > SLO to avoid large credit exposure.

sam: good call. also suggest an alert runbook: if sustained p90 > 350ms for 5 minutes, page eng-sre; for transient spikes notify CS channel.

mira: updated SLO draft to share with Helios: "SLO (onboarding 0-90d): - Uptime >= 99.95% monthly - p90 latency (interactive <=750 tokens) <= 300ms - p99 latency (interactive <=750 tokens) <= 900ms - Reporting: weekly digest + monthly SLA PDF - Credit policy: pro-rata single-month credit; escalation to renewal review after 2 breaches"

ana: procurement will want the credit calc example. can we include a numeric sample?

jared: sample from playbook (simplified): monthly invoice $10,000. uptime target 99.95%. observed uptime 99.85% -> shortfall 0.10% -> seconds_short = 0.001 * seconds_in_month (approx 2,592s) -> credit = invoice * (seconds_short / seconds_in_month) = $10,000 * 0.001 = $10. Adjust for minimum credit threshold (5 min) and SLA weighting. i'll paste canonical formula into the doc.

mira: action items: jared paste formal credit formula; sam publish alert runbook + dashboard link; evan add model-scope/fallback text; ana send invite + pre-call digest template. i'll send the SLO draft to Helios after we confirm wording.

ana: enablement scheduled 4/12 11am PT. adding product enablement and procurement.

sam: small ask: add onboarding survey question - "Are SLA expectations clear?" yes/no + comments. that'll help capture misalignment early.

evan: scoping note i'll add to the draft: "SLO applies to interactive routes only (/v1/generate, /v1/chat) — batch/embeddings excluded."

jared: credit calc snippet to paste into playbook: "downtime_ratio = downtime_seconds / seconds_in_billing_cycle; credit = invoice_amount * downtime_ratio; adjustments: apply SLA weighting and minimum threshold of 5 minutes."

deploy-bot: updated SLO template deployed to staging at 5101204722.

mira: thanks team. i'll review the staging SLO doc and send to Helios post-enablement. will update thread after the call. :thumbsup:
